Keyword Everywhere is a Chrome extension for any web browser designed to assist users with keyword research for SEO and marketing. This way, it shows data on search volume, cost per click, and competition for keywords that target actual SERPs and diverse online tools. It makes it easier for marketers or content creators to know the relevant keywords to put in their content, making them more efficient in what they do. The tool can be used by having connections with Google Search, YouTube, eBay, and other platforms where a user can spend enough time.
